description.zh-Hant: 把照片的主體拆解成大塊、完整的幾何色塊，像剪紙拼貼；柔和的配色、細微紙紋、大量留白與少量雜誌式文字。
description.en: Rebuilds the subject from large, complete geometric shapes like cut-paper collage, with a soft palette, subtle paper grain, generous negative space and minimal editorial type.

title.zh-Hant: 攝影 × 水彩方格拼貼

description.zh-Hant: 用數百枚水彩紙小方格重構照片主體，邊緣逐漸消散；暖白水彩紙背景、灰藍手寫短句，清新明亮。
description.en: Reconstructs the subject from hundreds of small watercolor-paper squares that dissolve toward the edges, on warm white paper with a short blue-gray handwritten line.
